summary: Profiles Internet mail (MIME and extended SMTP) for use as a way to exchange voice messages between voice mail systems. It was experimental and was replaced by RFC 2421, RFC 2422 and RFC 2423.

eli5.summary: Voice mail boxes from different makers could not talk to each other. This tells them to send recorded messages as regular email attachments so they can.
